Ameesha Patel dismisses Hardik Pandya romance rumours

Actress Ameesha Patel has dismissed speculation linking her romantically with cricketer Hardik Pandya. The rumours began after a video of them together went viral, leading to discussions on social media platforms like X and Reddit. Patel responded to a user on X who questioned her friendship with Pandya, stating that one does not necessarily have a girl as a friend just because they are seen together. The actress clarified that she has many male friends and that such speculation is baseless.
